Preserve detailed naturally hand-inked material texture with small broken lines, unlike a flat vector icon. Overhead map camera, upper-left soft light. Center one whole object on perfectly flat pure magenta #ff00ff, with12 percent clear margin. No ground, no scene, no cast shadow on background, no labels or extra objects. Match restrained reference medium, avoid the previous object's dramatic tonal contrast.
